description: Narrow v1 staggered difference-in-differences around the Callaway & Sant'Anna group-time ATT framework (did::att_gt). Estimates ATT(g,t) for treatment cohort g at time t, with an explicit comparison group, anticipation convention, and clustering/inference convention, then aggregates. NOT a blanket claim of numerical equivalence across all staggered estimators. This contract freeze scopes to the CS group-time ATT estimator (and its aggregation/event-time) as the reference v1; Sun&Abraham, Borusyak, de Chaisemartin et al. are NOT claimed as equivalent here.

references.name: Callaway & Sant'Anna 2021 — difference-in-differences with multiple time periods (group-time ATT)
csdid / drdid (Rios-Avila et al., Stata) — staggered DiD
Sun & Abraham 2021 — event study with heterogeneous treatment effects

methodology.note: V1 scope: Callaway&Sant'Anna group-time ATT(g,t) via did::att_gt (or a definition-compatible implementation), with explicit: treatment cohort / first-treatment timing, comparison group (never-treated or not-yet-treated), anticipation convention, clustering/inference convention, ATT(g,t), the aggregation used by the benchmark (e.g. att_gt simple/group/dynamic aggte), and event-time aggregation when exercised. Do not collapse different staggered-DiD estimators into one claim of numerical equivalence, and do not rout a heterogeneous staggered design to TWFE. ESTIMATOR-SPECIFIC logic lives in the Domain capability/adapter, never in Core.
